### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature.

### User Problem & Persona
Which target user does this serve (e.g. grandparents, first-time banking users) and what pain point does it solve?

### Proposed Solution
Describe how this feature should work from the user's perspective, emphasizing simplicity and accessibility.

### Accessibility & Simplicity Considerations
- How does this adhere to the minimum 56x56 touch target?
- Does it require voice support or Urdu translation?
- How does it prevent cognitive overload?

### Alternatives Considered
Any alternative approaches or workarounds considered.
